runtime.name: omp

assertions.evidence: Both Skill reads came from the disposable repository and no installed Skill cache participated.

The result preserves Node.js before npm test, port 4100, both commands, the test count, both expected outputs, the health URL, Ctrl+C, and their operational order.
The rewrite removes every fixture slop marker and uses direct numbered instructions.
The root inspected Git status, the full one-file diff, and the changed-path list.
The same root reran the exact command and captured one pass and zero failures.
The OMP root agent ran both checks without sudo or an operating-system user change.
Only project/docs/run-locally.md changed; the test hash matches the source fixture and diff check passes.
The task tool was unavailable and no child ran.
No commit, push, publication, or pull-request operation occurred.

limitations: The fixture verifies the document contract and does not start a real service.
OMP delivery remains D0 overall because the separate plugin-manager D1 gate is unresolved.
